notes:
Founder-led account (Elena Park, CEO). Early-stage ecommerce SaaS building an AI chat support widget for small merchants. Key points: 
- Wants hosted API (self-serve) but needs clearer pricing communication vs OpenAI/Anthropic — repeatedly: 'how does your per-token + model-selection compare in real dollars for 10k chats a month?'
- Cost sensitivity: likely <$1k/mo to start; wants path to scale without sudden bill spikes.
- Latency target: <300ms P50 for short chat queries; acceptable to have higher tail for long context.
- Models: prefer smaller cost-efficient models; open to recommended quantized variants. Concerned about hallucination on product return policies.
- Security: SMB needs basic SSO and audit logs; asked whether SOC2 report available for hosted product.
- Integration: Stripe billing questions, and wants ability to track token usage per workspace.
- Quote from call: 'If Redwood's pricing is within 20% of OpenAI and latency is similar, we'll migrate from our prototype.'
- Ask from SE: provide a sample monthly estimate for 10k chats (avg 80 tokens per chat, 8M tokens/mo) across two model choices.
- Linked assets: pricing deck + quickstart.
- Risk: founder is cost-first and will re-evaluate if numbers unclear; could sign self-serve but needs simple calculator and an example invoice.
- Tone: pragmatic, fast-moving; decision authority is founder, technical validation by lead engineer.
pitch_summary: Position Redwood as predictable, cost-transparent hosted API: provide per-token examples, recommended smaller models, caching/batching tips to lower unit cost. Emphasize self-serve onboarding, quickstart, and visible token dashboards.
